name: REL proto-oncogene, NF-kB subunit

function.text: REL encodes proto-oncogene c-Rel. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and non-canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: REL mutation or amplification has been associated with B-cell lymphomas, including Hodgkin lymphoma.
